svg.title: mucronaspis-oslo-asker-4209 - original atlas schematic
svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Original generalized dalmanitid trilobite schematic with genal spines and a pointed tail spine for a genus-rank Mucronaspis sp. record; not a species diagnosis, not the Oslo-Asker specimen and no exact segment count. The Hirnantian age envelope does not date this individual exactly to 445 Ma or establish continuous existence.
